apiUsage.title: Use the API
apiUsage.description: To send transactions from a script or iPhone Shortcuts.
apiUsage.addressHint: Send a POST request with the token in the Authorization header. A draft lands in To review and you are notified.
apiUsage.tokenHint: Put your token in place of ff_….
apiUsage.step1: Open the Shortcuts app and make a new shortcut.
apiUsage.step2: Add the «Get Contents of URL» action and paste the address above.
apiUsage.step4: Headers: Authorization = Bearer {{token}}, and Content-Type = application/json.
apiUsage.step5: Request Body: JSON, with the fields below (example).
apiUsage.step6: Amount and date can come from the shortcut's variables. The first time, allow access to this address.
apiUsage.iosNotifications: iOS doesn't give Shortcuts the text of other apps' notifications: the shortcut starts from an automation on messages or e-mail, from a tap on the Home Screen or from the Share menu.
apiUsage.field_occurredAt: When it happened, in local time there: 2026-10-28T12:30:00, no offset.
apiUsage.field_direction: out if you spent, in if you received. Left out, you decide when reviewing.
apiUsage.field_timezone: Zone of the date, e.g. Europe/Rome. Yours when left out.
apiUsage.field_rawText: The original text, e.g. of the notification. Shown when reviewing.
apiUsage.field_ifExists: What to do if an identical transaction is there already: review (ask you, the default), skip, annotate or create.
apiUsage.ifExistsHint: Identical: same amount to the cent, within a day, on the same account when given. A draft matching an expected recurring transaction is recorded by itself.
apiUsage.specHint: Every endpoint, field and response, to open in Postman, Insomnia or a client generator. Always up to date with this version.

androidApp.title: Android app
androidApp.description: Reads your bank's notifications and sends them here to review.
androidApp.step1: Create a "Drafts only" token below, e.g. "Phone".
androidApp.step2: Download the app on the phone and install it (Android asks to allow installing from this source).
androidApp.step3: Open it, write this server's address and the token, then "Save and check".
androidApp.step4: Give the app access to notifications.
androidApp.step5: In "Choose apps" turn on your bank's app. Then pick its account in Sources.
